answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 12163 Country: India Title: Assalamualikum Mufti Sb., What to do if one forget to recite Surah-Fatiha and only recited Zammu Surah in any Fard (Compulsary) Salaah(Namaz) / Wajib/ Nafil / Sunnah ? Question: Assalamualikum Mufti Sb., What to do if one forget to recite Surah-Fatiha and only recited Zammu Surah in any Fard (Compulsary) Salaah(Namaz) / Wajib/ Nafil / Sunnah ? Will the sajda sahu will be sufficient in such case? Answer ID: 12163 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 614/614=L/1430) Yes, the salah will be complete and valid if he performs the sajdah sahv (remedial prostration). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
